title: Necessary and sufficient conditions for the martingale property of stochastic exponentials driven by multi-dimensional diffusions
abstract: arXiv:2611.07083v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give necessary and sufficient coefficient conditions for stochastic exponentials driven by multidimensional diffusions to be true martingales. The classical reduction to non-exit of the diffusion with Girsanov-shifted drift separates the analysis into smooth boundary points, infinity, and nonsmooth boundary pieces. On smooth domains, under regularity and non-explosion hypotheses, martingality is equivalent to nonpositivity of the shifted Fichera drift, provided an explicit local condition holds where that drift vanishes and the stochastic integrand is unbounded. At infinity, Feller's test gives exact criteria when a scalar function of the diffusion reduces to a one-dimensional diffusion up to a time change with rate bounded above and away from zero. General radial and projection tests supply sufficient conditions. Applications give explicit necessary and sufficient conditions for inverse-CIR and $4/2$ models with correlated factors

translated_title: 由多维扩散过程驱动的随机指数鞅性质的充要条件
translated_abstract: 我们给出了由多维扩散过程驱动的随机指数成为真鞅的系数充要条件。通过带有Girsanov平移漂移的扩散过程不越出区域的经典约化方法，我们将分析分为光滑边界点、无穷远处以及非光滑边界部分。在光滑区域上，在正则性与非爆炸性假设下，鞅性等价于平移后的Fichera漂移的非正性，前提是在该漂移消失且随机被积函数无界处满足一个显式的局部条件。在无穷远处，当扩散过程的某个标量函数经过一个速率有上下界的时间变换后约化为一维扩散时，Feller检验给出精确判据。一般的径向检验和投影检验提供充分条件。应用部分给出了具有相关因子的逆CIR模型和4/2模型的显式充要条件。
tldr: 本文给出了由多维扩散驱动的随机指数成为真鞅的系数充要条件，将分析分解为光滑边界上平移Fichera漂移的非正性判据、无穷远处基于Feller检验的精确准则以及非光滑边界情形，并应用于具有相关因子的逆CIR和4/2模型。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes necessary and sufficient coefficient conditions for stochastic exponentials driven by multidimensional diffusions to be true martingales, separating the analysis into nonpositivity of the shifted Fichera drift at smooth boundaries, exact criteria via Feller's test at infinity, and nonsmooth boundary cases, with applications to inverse-CIR and 4/2 models with correlated factors.
